description.zh: 默认加密或脱敏算法名称
description.en: Name of the default encryption or masking algorithm

description.zh: 规则算法，可选多个，脱敏算法可以额外添加参数。格式：{name：算法1}，{name：算法2，params：{加密位置，加密位数}}
description.en: Rule algorithm. Multiple algorithms can be selected. Masking Algorithm can include additional parameters. Format: {name: algorithm1}, {name: algorithm2, params: {encryption position, number of encrypted characters}}

description.zh: 规则配置，JSON字符串格式，包含数据库、表、列的匹配规则
description.en: Rule configuration, in JSON string format, containing matching rules for databases, tables, and columns

description.zh: 规则名称（一次仅支持输入一个规则名称）
description.en: Rule Name (only one rule name is supported per request)

title.en: Create an Encryption or Desensitization Rule

descriptions.zh:
## 请求说明
- 在使用此接口前，请确保已在 DAS 安全中心 开通列加密服务。
- 如果在调用接口时收到错误信息ColumnEncryptionErrorCode.NOT_PURCHASED，请前往 DAS（数据库自治服务）安全中心 购买并开通列加密服务后再使用。
descriptions.en:
## Request Description
- Before using this API, ensure that you have enabled the column encryption service in DAS Security Center.
- If you receive the error message ColumnEncryptionErrorCode.NOT_PURCHASED when invoking the API, go to the DAS (Database Autonomy Service) Security Center to purchase and enable the column encryption service before using it again.

example.unifiedCli: aliyun rds create-masking-rules --rule-name rulename1 --masking-algo name_:_aes-128-gcm_,_name_:_sm4-128-gcm --default-algo aes-128-gcm --rule-config '{"Databases":["testdb"],"Columns":["a"],"Tables":["testtb"]}' --db-instance-name rm-t4n8t18o300000d5 --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --db-name testdb --region cn-hangzhou
example.legacyCli: aliyun rds CreateMaskingRules --region cn-hangzhou --DefaultAlgo 'aes-128-gcm' --DBName testdb --RuleConfig '{"Databases":["testdb"],"Columns":["a"],"Tables":["testtb"]}' --RegionId 'cn-hangzhou' --RuleName rulename1 --MaskingAlgo 'name_:_aes-128-gcm_,_name_:_sm4-128-gcm' --DBInstanceName 'rm-t4n8t18o300000d5'
